operator_notes: Many docs.google.com/viewer iframes load slowly (2–4 min) — ignore previews.
Bulletin is a Word file at onewebmedia/NEWSLETTER D-M-YY.docx — download directly.
Iframe src URLs are in the HTML immediately; no need to wait for previews.
Harvester rewrites the date each Sunday and tries filename variants (spaces before .docx).
do_not: Do not pick the first iframe PDF — often a GDPR or Privacy notice.
Do not use goto-only recipes on this page.
Do not train on financial-statement or admin docx files.

Do not set use_captured_url:true on the download step — it disables the date-rewriting in oneweb_newsletter_download_urls() that this recipe depends on (see operator_notes above), silently freezing on the trained week's file forever (bug pattern #1, found 2026-08-09: was still serving the 21/06/2026 file 7 weeks later).
operator_notes_2026_08_09: use_captured_url was true, which short-circuits _resolve_download_candidates to return only the literal trained URL (harvester/replay.py: 'if use_captured_url or not target_date: return [step_url]') — the date-rewrite candidates from oneweb_newsletter_download_urls() were never tried. Set to false; verified locally that it now generates 'NEWSLETTER 9-8-26.docx' (+ space-suffix variants) for the 09/08/2026 target.
